arguments.value: Leonard Terry Strand, born in 1965 in Sioux City, Iowa, is a United States District Judge for the Northern District of Iowa. Nominated by President Barack Obama on July 21, 2015, to a seat vacated by Mark W. Bennett, he was confirmed by the Senate on February 11, 2016, and received his commission on February 12, 2016. He previously served as a U.S. Magistrate Judge for the Northern District of Iowa from 2012 to 2016. Strand earned a B.A. from the University of Iowa in 1987 and a J.D. from the University of Iowa College of Law in 1990, and practiced privately in Cedar Rapids, Iowa, from 1990 to 2012.
